Exact historical claim versions and evidence pointers are recorded in research/DRAFT_REVIEW_INDEX.json. Assess conditional finite statements, quantitative analytic arguments, attributed background results and undischarged manuscript obligations separately; no new error search or whole-manuscript certification.

definitions.W: An upper bound at most one for the sum of original assigned masses m_i=k_i delta_i of retained objects, not adaptive surviving mass
definitions.scope: An Engineer assessment is not Host-invoked independent Reviewer acceptance; historical Lean evidence is not a fresh local compiler verdict

claims.natural_statement: Under the stipulated core-equivariant finite projected-table histories, mask transitions, injective ancestors and growing chronology, the backward-charge implication has one continuing branch, separately stopped nonnegative losses, exact reciprocal later-omission factors and capacity bounds preserving independent or common outer currency without repeated first-sharing epochs. This is the finite assertion of old C_BC v2, not the analytic construction or the main conjecture.

For all stipulated retained-centre, good-mask, preliminary-cell-test data and admissible finite histories with sum_i m_i<=W<=1, the broad and same-width common-mask narrow remaining first-join counts are O_k0(W^(201/200)), uniformly in block, history and slot cap N_0, with claimed oriented mixed roundoff O_k0(W^2). This is the assertion of old C_RFJ_QUANT v5; its analytic proof, including all claimed interface discharges, is to be assessed.

For every rational gamma=A/B in lowest terms and nonnegative psi with sum_q phi(q)psi(q)/q divergent, almost every x has infinitely many inhomogeneous approximations with shift-adapted coprimality (A+aB,q)=1. The source non-strict inequality implies the strict weak inequality by applying the theorem to psi/2.

For each monotone function f tending to infinity there exists an explicitly constructible Liouville shift gamma depending only on f for which every psi satisfying either of the extra-divergence lower bounds in Beresnevich-Hauke-Velani Theorem 18 has the almost-everywhere weak approximation conclusion. The shift is existential, not an arbitrary prescribed irrational.

The old finite backward-charge evidence and the claimed remaining-first-join estimates do not by themselves establish the arbitrary-fixed-real-shift weak inhomogeneous Duffin-Schaeffer conclusion: direct birth comparisons, sparse weighted sums, partition existence and losses, and the final finite-construction/second-moment reduction remain separate unverified obligations in the inventoried Argus work.

For all stipulated retained-centre, good-mask, preliminary-cell-test data and admissible finite histories with sum_i m_i<=W<=1, the broad and same-width common-mask narrow remaining first-join counts are O_k0(W^(201/200)), uniformly in block, history and slot cap N_0, with claimed oriented mixed roundoff O_k0(W^2). This is the assertion of old C_RFJ_QUANT v5; its analytic proof, including all claimed interface discharges, is to be assessed.
